register_model_family: register a new model family with a factory, state dict converter, and optional FSDP applier to a dependency container
register_all_model_families: call _register_model_families to register all built-in model families including LLaMA, Mistral, Gemma, and wav2vec into the container
use_advanced_model_factory: implement the AdvancedModelFactory protocol to create models with access to a dependency resolver and config
register_llama_model_family: register the LLaMA model family with its compiler, FSDP applier, and layerwise activation checkpointing applier
register_huggingface_model_family: register the HuggingFace model family with its FSDP applier and factory for loading arbitrary HuggingFace models
